Our Heritage & Philosophy

Dakshina Tel Mill

Two Distinct Culinary Traditions, One Uncompromising Standard

Based in Hetauda, Nepal, Dakshina Tel Mill is dedicated to processing high-grade mustard seeds with unmatched care. Whether you prefer the intense aroma and fiery depth of traditional roasted Chepuwa oil or the nutrient-dense purity of natural cold-pressed Kacchi Ghani oil, Dakshina delivers authentic excellence to every kitchen and merchant.

Traditional Roasted (भुटेको चेपुवा)

Slow-roasted seeds pressed for robust aroma, pungent punch, and deep golden color.

Pure Cold-Pressed (कच्ची घानी)

Pressed without thermal degradation to safeguard essential fatty acids and antioxidants.

Product Comparison & Culinary Recommendations

Roasted Mustard Oil (Chepuwa)

Recommended for traditional pickles, spicy meat preparations, curries, and high-heat stir frying requiring authentic pungency.

Cold-Pressed Mustard Oil (Kacchi Ghani)

Unheated extraction preserving vitamin E, natural antioxidants, and essential fatty acids. Ideal for daily health cooking.

From Selected Mustard Seeds to Sealed Cartons

Line 01

Roasted Chepuwa Processing

Thermal seed roaster gently preheats selected tori seeds before slow pressing, developing trademark Nepali aroma, dark golden clarity, and pungent punch.

  • Carefully controlled seed roasting
  • Available in 500ml & 1000ml pouches
Line 02

Pure Cold-Pressed (Kacchi Ghani)

Virgin mechanical extraction without thermal heating, safeguarding natural vitamin E, omega fatty acids, and wholesome vitality.

  • Cold-pressed virgin extraction below 45°C
  • Available in 500ml & 1000ml pouches
